notes.title: Grisaia Phantom Trigger Chinese language version
notes.notes:
We have almost finished the Chinese language localization of Grisaia Phantom Trigger Volume 1 and 2, and in the next few days we are going to push an update wich will add this language. 
We will post another announcement once the update is live. For more information in Chinese about our games etc. please visit our Weibo [url=https://weibo.com/6534491650/profile?topnav=1&wvr=6]official account[/url].

notes.title: Grisaia Phantom Trigger Vol.1&2 Chinese release coming soon!
notes.notes: We are currently working on adding Chinese language support for Grisaia Phantom Trigger Vol.1&2. Please stay tuned for more information soon.
